title: Laredo man booked on assault and resisting arrest charges
excerpt: Roel Sotero Lara was booked into the Webb County Jail on November 1, 2026, on alleged charges of assault causing bodily injury and resisting arrest, according to Webb County booking records.
content:
Roel Sotero Lara was booked into the Webb County Jail on November 1, 2026, at 5:16 a.m., according to Webb County booking records.

The booking agency listed is the Laredo Police Department.

He was allegedly booked on assault causing bodily injury, listed twice, and resisting arrest.

Bond had not been set in the record checked.

Webb Watch 956 has requested his official booking photograph from Webb County. No photograph has been received yet, and this story is published without a photograph.

The charges are allegations, not convictions, and he is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

  • Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search
  • Webb County public-access court records
